add.text: The Malawi rift is part of a linear chain of rift lakes that extends from the southern tip of the Red Sea to Mozambique, with Lake Malawi the southernmost linear lake feature.
When an island arc collides with a continent, the subduction zone switches to the other side of the island.
Ground sloths evolved mainly in South America during the late Paleogene and Neogene, while the continent was isolated.
The ancestors of humans split from the ancestors of chimpanzees around the end of the Miocene, during the final Messinian Stage (7.5-5.3 Ma).
The Dead Sea Transform is a left-lateral series of faults between the Sinai Peninsula and the Arabia Plate.
Left steps in this transform have opened a series of wrench basins, including the Dead Sea.
The Miocene-Pliocene boundary coincides with the time of the Messinian salinity crisis.
A frozen steppe bison mummy from northern Yakutia shows it was a pasture grazer living in a habitat that was becoming dominated by shrub and tundra vegetation.
Bison in Alaska and the Yukon survived the loss of the mammoth steppe.
Menengai sits in the Great Rift Valley, part of an intra-continental system of depressions running north to south through Kenya.
Some geological processes make circular or near-circular features that can be mistaken for impact craters.
Later eruptions of modern Pinatubo came in episodes much shorter than the quiet intervals between them.
The maximum size of eruptions in each period has been getting smaller over modern Pinatubo's 35,000-year history, though this might be an artifact of older deposits being eroded and buried.
A sector collapse is the catastrophic failure of a significant part of a volcano, creating a large debris avalanche.
Mount Rainier has had large debris avalanches and enormous lahars, owing to the large amount of glacial ice on it.
A structure must meet a stringent set of established criteria to be confirmed as an impact crater.
Proposing that Burckle (30 km) formed within the last few millennia has been met with skepticism, since almost all confirmed craters younger than a million years are under two km across.
Lake Baikal in Siberia is a modern example of a rift basin.
Carnassial teeth sit near the front of the molar row in carnivorans but near the back in creodonts, suggesting separate evolutionary histories and an order-level distinction.
Sea levels were lower in the Oligocene than in the early Eocene, exposing large coastal plains in Europe.
By the end of the Eocene-Oligocene transition, sea levels had dropped by 105 meters.
The Eocene-Oligocene transition in Europe and Asia has been called the Grande Coupure.
Aridity in the Atacama predates the rise of the Central Andes, but hyper-aridity is generally thought to have resulted from that rise.
The most arid part lies between the Andes and the Chilean Coast Range, which block moisture from both the Pacific and the Atlantic, creating a two-sided rain shadow.
The Haughton crater's Oligocene date is now considered questionable, as later analyses have concluded it dates to 39 Ma, placing the event in the Eocene.
Embrithopods arose in the Early Eocene.
Some experts think embrithopods could not compete with invading mammals because of their generalized habits and phyletic conservatism.
Like modern elephants, gomphotheres may have knocked down trees, creating open landscapes.
